newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia year-on-year CPI up 3.3 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia year-on-year CPI up 3.3 pct in November.

text.p: Malaysia's Consumer Price Index (CPI) for November rose 3.3 percent from the same month a year ago, the Statistics Department said on Wednesday.
The department said the CPI in November 1996 was up 0.5 pct from October 1996. In October 1996, the index grew by 3.4 percent on a year-on-year basis.
The index rose 3.5 percent for the first 11 months of the year, and also gained 3.5 percent in the corresponding period of last year.
